study type: Matched retrospective observational case-control cohort study
cohort: 88 pregnant women who underwent successful external cephalic version (sECV) and 176 controls with spontaneous cephalic presentation
finding: Women who have a successful external cephalic version are at increased risk of Cesarean section after subsequent induction of labor.
mod_finding: Women who have a successful external cephalic version are at an increased risk of caesarean section after subsequent induction of labor.
